name: Resize image
label: Make it the right size
description: Resize JPG, PNG and WebP images to exact dimensions or fit them inside a bounding box.
how: Choose an image from your device.
Enter a width and height. Keep proportions to fit inside those dimensions.
Create your image and download the result.
faq: Keeping proportions fits the image inside your chosen width and height. Turning it off stretches the image to those exact dimensions.

name: Compress image
label: Less weight. Same story.
description: Reduce image file size with adjustable quality and an optional target in KB.
how: Choose a JPG, PNG or WebP image.
Select JPG or WebP, then set quality or a target file size.
Compare the output size and download. If the target is too small, reduce dimensions first.
faq: Compression cannot guarantee every size target. The tool reports whether it reached your target. PNG inputs are converted to the selected format; JPG uses a white background for transparency.

name: Convert image
label: A format that fits
description: Convert between JPG, PNG and WebP in your browser, with a preview before download.
how: Choose JPG, PNG or WebP as the output format.
Create and download the converted image.
faq: PNG and WebP can preserve transparency. JPG cannot, so transparent areas become white. Animated files, SVG and HEIC are not supported.

name: Merge PDF
label: Bring it all together
description: Combine multiple PDF files into a single document in the order you choose.
how: Choose two or more PDF files.
Move files up or down to arrange the final document.
Merge and download your combined PDF.
faq: Password-protected PDFs are not supported. Page content is copied, but interactive forms, bookmarks, attachments and digital signatures may not survive. Keep your originals.

name: Organize PDF
label: Just the pages you need
description: Extract, duplicate or reorder PDF pages by choosing a custom page sequence.
how: Choose one PDF and check its page count.
Enter pages such as 3,1-2 to extract or reorder them. Repeating a page duplicates it.
Create and download a new PDF containing your selection.
faq: Page numbers start at 1. A range such as 4-2 reverses those pages. This tool produces one selected-pages PDF, not a ZIP of separate files.

name: Images to PDF
label: Your pictures, one document
description: Turn JPG, PNG and WebP images into a neatly arranged PDF with one image per page.
how: Choose your images and arrange them in order.
Choose A4, Letter or pages sized to each image.
faq: Images fit inside the page without cropping. A4 and Letter use white margins. Text in a photograph stays an image: this tool does not perform OCR.
